extracted.name: Summer Fruit Salad with Mint Dressing
extracted.description: This summer fruit salad with mint dressing recipe features watermelon, strawberries, peaches, nectarines, pear, and grapes in a lemon-mint dressing.
ingredient_lines: 2 large fresh peaches, cut into cubes
1 red Anjou pear, cut into cubes
0.25 cup minced fresh mint (chocolate mint preferred)
instruction_lines: Combine watermelon, strawberries, peaches, nectarines, pear, and grapes in a large bowl.
Whisk lemon zest, lemon juice, mint, and honey together in a small bowl; drizzle over fruit mixture and toss to coat.
